This '''damaged Viper probe droid''' was a [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper]] [[Probe droid/Legends|probe]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Some time around the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], a pivotal conflict in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the Galactic Empire and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], this probe droid was damaged and stranded, still in its [[Hyperdrive pod/Legends|transport pod]], near the [[Saila Na system/Legends|Saila Na]] [[Star system/Legends|system]].

Shortly after the [[Battle of Hospital]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the droid became a target of [[Aeron Azzameen]] after she learned of its existence and a mission to capture the droid by [[Slicer/Legends|slicing]] communications systems. She wished to capture the damaged droid to utilize its sensors and components against [[Azzameen family|her family's]] conflict between [[Twin Suns Transport Services/Legends|their company]] and their rivals, [[Viraxo Industries]]. To retrieve the droid, she sent her brother [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace]] and family droid [[MK-09/Legends|MK-09]] in the family's [[YT-2000 light freighter/Legends|YT-2000]] [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] ''[[Otana/Legends|Otana]]''. The [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Muurian transport|transport]] ''[[Pelican]]'' also intended to [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenge]] the droid; accompanied by [[Scavenger (pirate squadron)|several]] [[R-41 Starchaser]] [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]], this [[Transport/Legends|transport]] reached the damaged probe droid first. Before they were able to leave, however, the ''Otana'' [[Mission to the Saila Na system|destroyed]] the entire [[Squadron/Legends|group]] and Ace took the probe for himself.

After retrieving the probe droid, the ''Otana'' made its way to the civilian checkpoint [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] platform [[Tinoon Station]], cargo in tow. Fearing detection, Ace planned to illegally pass through the checkpoint and escape the system. The [[Skirmish above Tinoon|arrival]] of a pirate force consisting of [[Marauder-class Assault Corvette/Legends|Marauder-class corvettes]] and [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] provided ample distraction, but Ace challenged the incoming force. After a victorious skirmish between the pirates, the ''Otana'', and the [[Golan II Space Defense SpaceGun]] Tinoon Station, the ''Otana'' and its probe droid pod payload were allowed to pass without inspection.
